rules.locator: LessonII,Crystal Gazing:paragraphs beginning Various teachers and Others have advocated
rules.statement: The source lists crystal,glass,dark-backed watch glass,polished metal,ink,water in blackened cups,and precious stones;LessonVI also mentions clear water in a bottle.

rules.locator: LessonII,Crystal Gazing:paragraph beginning There are but very few directions
rules.statement: The source places the gazer with their back toward the light.

rules.locator: LessonII,Crystal Gazing:paragraph beginning The simple general direction
rules.statement: A quiet room and a table with dark cloth are suggested.
The gaze is calm;blinking is permitted and eye strain or fatigue is discouraged.

rules.locator: LessonII,Crystal Gazing:paragraph beginning An English authority recommends
rules.statement: Optional familiar-object visualization is described as an exercise,not an independently verified perception.

rules.locator: LessonII,Crystal Gazing:paragraph beginning The first signs
rules.statement: The author describes mist and developing pictures as claimed experiences;the application does not require or validate them.

rules.locator: LessonVI,Crystal Gazing:Stead quotation beginning You simply look
rules.statement: The quoted example describes a brief two-to-three-minute look without fatigue;this is not a required timer or promise.
The quotation describes fixing thought on a chosen subject.

water_glass.description: Clear water in a glass bottle

workflow.text: Choose the declared surface;review the historical lighting and dark-support suggestions. Record actual conditions separately.
Optionally state an intention in your own words. It is context,not a target the application can verify.
Gaze calmly and blink normally;avoid strain. The historical brief example is optional. Stop at any point;no imagery is required.
Record only your own experience,including uncertainty or nothing noticed. Distinguish reflection,subjective imagery and deliberate imagination.
Keep personal associations separate from the raw record;no universal symbolic meaning is assigned.
Review your notes and intention without turning them into claims about hidden facts or future events.

journal_policy: Optional missing/null/empty journal;raw descriptions,associations and reflections preserved verbatim. Input-list order is primary;optional sequence numbers strictly increase without sorting. Missing type remains unclassified,not inferred. Timestamps are user declarations with no current-time default.
limits: The application cannot observe the environment,gaze or visual experience
Historical astral/telepathic accounts are author beliefs,not scientific validation
No universal scrying dictionary,aura-color diagnosis,entity detection,hidden memories or factual prediction
No required prolonged stare,sensory deprivation or altered state;stopping and no imagery remain valid
No creative imagery or seeded scene system in this core
